textSegments:
Smart BX1 550W (DC to DC Version)
 – Thermaltake Global
80 PLUS Bronze certified non-modular PSU with 120mm Hydraulic Bearing fan.

Built to deliver 80 PLUS with 85% power efficiency, the Smart BX1 series is available in 550W - 750W models. With an ample 5-year warranty, the Smart BX1 is able to satisfy the market, where value-oriented users are looking for a new power supply with reliable performance.
Equipped with 120mm cooling fan with intelligent RPM control guarantees cool performance and silent operation.
The cables used for Smart BX1 Series are black and low-profile, users are able to properly route the cables in optimal location to prevent airflow blockage.
Providing great durability as well as offering the highest stability, while remaining reliable.
High Amperage Single +12V Rail & DC to DC Design

Smart BX1 Series is equipped with powerful +12V rails, superior performance under all types of system loading. The use of DC to DC circuit design provides very stable operation and enhanced voltage regulation.

To protect the hardware, Smart BX1 series is built with industry grade protections: OCP(Over Current Protection), OVP (Over Voltage Protection), UVP(Under Voltage Protection), OPP(Over Power Protection), SCP(Short Circuit Protection), OTP(Over Temperature Protection).
80 PLUS Bronze Certified and Intel C6/C7 States Ready

Smart BX1 Series saves energy through its high energy efficiency of up to 85% and is 80 PLUS® Bronze certified. It has been optimized to work with all generations of Intel’s processors to achieve maximum energy saving.
